evals.prompt: Audit the landing page design for low contrast text, improper typography hierarchy, and cramped mobile layout.
evals.expected_output: The agent captures viewports, audits visual elements using the checklist, flags contrast and layout bugs, and applies CSS fixes.
expectations: Visual QA inspection tests multiple viewport sizes
Low contrast text and hierarchy flaws are flagged using the visual QA checklist
Actionable CSS remedies are proposed or applied

evals.prompt: Review a dashboard table component to ensure empty, loading, and error states are properly implemented.
evals.expected_output: The agent evaluates missing UI states and recommends skeleton loaders and empty state indicators.
expectations: Missing UI states (loading, empty, error) are detected
Anti-patterns in table spacing and visual noise are identified
